subject: How to set up Stripe payment gateway?
body: Hi support, we are trying to connect our Stripe account to Brilliant Directories. Which menu do we go to to enter our secret and publishable keys?

subject: Where is test mode for payments?
body: Hello, we want to test credit card transactions before launching. Can we enable test mode in the payment settings?

subject: Supported payment gateways inquiry
body: Hi team, which gateways can we use natively with Brilliant Directories? Do you support PayPal Standard and Stripe?

subject: How do I customize sidebar search filters?
body: Can we add custom dropdown filters to the sidebar search without custom code? Where is the Form Manager located?

subject: Enabling location radius search
body: Hi, our directory visitors want to search for members by radius in miles. How do we turn this on in Search Settings?

subject: Editing system email templates
body: Where can we edit the welcome email sent out to new members when they sign up?

subject: Adding Google Maps API key
body: Our maps are showing an error watermark. Where in the General Settings do we paste our Google Maps API key?

subject: Importing members via CSV file
body: We have 500 members in an Excel sheet. What are the mandatory fields required to import them via CSV?

subject: Changing default directory currency
body: We are based in the UK. How do we change the currency from USD to GBP in Finance settings?

subject: Allowing members to cancel self-service
body: Can members cancel their accounts directly from their dashboard settings, or do we have to cancel them manually?

subject: Adding custom CSS styles
body: Where can we insert CSS overrides so they do not get erased when default templates update?

subject: Connecting custom domain forwarders
body: How do we forward info@ourdomain.com to our primary support inbox inside BD?

subject: Stripe payment failing on checkout
body: Several members report transaction errors at checkout. Could this be caused by test mode being enabled or invalid webhook keys?

subject: Radius search not returning results
body: When typing a zip code, no results appear. Is the Google Places API enabled properly?

subject: Member import failing on line 42
body: The CSV import stops at row 42 with a missing plan ID error. What format does the plan ID require?

subject: Email notifications going to spam
body: Our member welcome emails are landing in spam folders. How do we configure SPF and DKIM records?

subject: Custom CSS not rendering on mobile
body: The changes we added in Design Settings Custom CSS are not appearing on mobile devices.

subject: Webhook failure notification from Stripe
body: Stripe sent an alert that invoice.payment_succeeded webhook endpoint returned a 500 error.

subject: Member dashboard button greyed out
body: One of our premium members cannot click the publish article button. Which permission setting controls this?

subject: Categories not linking to search results
body: Clicking subcategory links on the homepage shows a 404 page.

subject: Transaction history missing recent charges
body: We see payments in our Stripe account but they do not appear in BD Transaction History.

subject: SSL certificate warning on custom domain
body: Visitors see an insecure warning when accessing our root domain.

subject: Need custom multi-step booking integration
body: We want to build a custom calendar booking system inside our listing profiles with SMS reminders.

subject: Mobile app wrapper for iOS and Android
body: Can your consulting team build a native mobile app wrapper for our directory website?

subject: Enterprise SSO integration with Okta
body: We need SAML 2.0 single sign-on with Okta for our corporate directory members.

subject: Custom marketplace escrow payment flow
body: We want buyers to pay sellers directly and take a 10% commission via Stripe Connect Custom.

subject: AI chat widget embedded in member profiles
body: Can you build an AI consultant bot on every member profile that answers questions about that vendor?

subject: Custom lead distribution CRM webhook engine
body: We want incoming leads automatically parsed and auctioned to the highest bidding directory member.

subject: Requesting immediate refund for annual plan
body: We accidentally renewed our annual plan yesterday. Please cancel our account and refund  immediately.

subject: Cancel subscription and confirmation required
body: Please cancel my monthly membership plan immediately and confirm no further charges will be billed.

subject: Double charged this morning
body: I was charged twice ( x 2) for invoice #8841. Please refund the duplicate transaction.

subject: Dissatisfied with platform, requesting partial refund
body: We only used the site for 3 days and it does not fit our business. Can we get a prorated refund?

subject: Cancel trial before billing date
body: Our 14 day trial ends tomorrow. Please cancel it now so our credit card is not billed.

subject: Disputed charge inquiry from bank
body: Our finance department flagged an unrecognized charge of  from your company. Please explain or refund.

subject: Site down during peak traffic hours
body: Our website was unreachable for 2 hours during our annual conference launch. We lost thousands in ticket sales.

subject: Unacceptable delay in support response
body: I submitted a ticket 4 days ago regarding broken checkout and have received no reply. This is completely unacceptable.

subject: Latest template update broke custom layout
body: Your latest system update wiped out our custom header navigation. Fix this immediately.

subject: Spam members creating fake profiles
body: Our directory is getting flooded with bot signups and spam listings. Why is reCAPTCHA not stopping them?

subject: Billing error overcharged our account
body: You billed us the enterprise tier instead of professional tier for two months in a row. We demand an explanation.

subject: Search results showing wrong distances
body: Members located 50 miles away are listed as 2 miles away. Our customers are complaining about false info.

subject: Quote for migrating 10,000 members from WordPress
body: We want to migrate from WordPress/GeoDirectory to Brilliant Directories. Can you provide an estimate and timeline?

subject: Cost to customize checkout design and invoice PDF
body: What is the cost to redesign our member checkout page and add custom company tax fields to PDF receipts?

subject: Estimate for custom Zapier webhooks integration
body: We need real-time member signup data sent to HubSpot via custom webhooks. How many developer hours is this?

subject: Quote for full turnkey website setup
body: We bought a Brilliant Directories license but want a professional consultant team to do the complete setup.

subject: Cost for custom search algorithm by member review rating
body: We want search results sorted by a custom weighted review formula. How much would this custom widget cost?

subject: Following up on custom design quote sent last Tuesday
body: Hi, just following up on our request for the homepage redesign quote. Has the tech lead reviewed the scope yet?

subject: Status of ticket #4401 - DNS configuration
body: Hello, checking in to see if our DNS records have been verified by your technical team.

subject: Any updates on the Stripe recurring billing bug?
body: Hi, we spoke on Friday about the invoice recurring billing sync issue. Any update on the fix?

subject: Follow-up regarding our meeting notes from yesterday
body: Thanks for the discovery call yesterday. When can we expect the SOW and hours breakdown proposal?

subject: Second follow-up: pending refund confirmation for invoice 992
body: Following up again regarding invoice 992 refund. Support said it would process in 48 hours but we have not seen it.
